children: Argentina's industrial output fell 4.9% in July compared to the same month last year in non-seasonally adjusted terms, data from national statistics agency INDEC showed on Tuesday.
July's industrial output in South America's second-largest economy decreased 5.0% compared to June in seasonally adjusted terms, according to the INDEC data.
